properties.name: ML-DSA-65 (Module-Lattice-Based Digital Signature Algorithm)
properties.complexity_bounds: O(k * n log n) polynomial matrix-vector products, n=256, k=6, l=5
properties.algebraic_structure: Module over polynomial ring R_q = Z_q[X]/(X^256 + 1) with q = 8380417

properties.name: Forward and Inverse NTT over Z_8380417[X]/(X^256 + 1)
properties.complexity_bounds: Time: O(N log N) modular multiplications; Space: O(N), N=256
properties.ring_modulus: q = 8380417 = 2^23 - 2^13 + 1, primitive 512th root of unity w = 1753
properties.algorithm_variant: Cooley-Tukey (Forward) / Gentleman-Sande (Inverse) butterfly with Montgomery/Barrett reduction

properties.name: ARM NEON / Advanced SIMD Architecture Extension
properties.throughput_bounds: 4 parallel 32-bit signed/unsigned integer vector ops per 128-bit SIMD instruction

properties.microarchitectural_effect: Multiply packed 32-bit integers in Vn and Vm, store lower 32-bit results in Vd
Signed saturating doubling multiply high, returning upper 32 bits of 2*Vn*Vm product

properties.volatile_status: Caller-saved V0-V7, V16-V31; Callee-saved V8-V15 lower 64-bits (AAPCS64)

properties.operation: Accelerates NTT-based polynomial multiplication for matrix-vector expansion and signature verification

properties.vector_width: 4x 32-bit modular coefficients processed in parallel per 128-bit NEON lane

properties.stage: Low 32-bit product computation phase in Montgomery modular reduction step
High signed product phase for fast modular reduction over prime q = 8380417

properties.access_pattern: Read/Write 128-bit vector register holding 4 packed 32-bit polynomial coefficients
Read/Write 128-bit vector register containing high-half modular butterfly multiplication products

evidence.reference: NIST FIPS 204: Module-Lattice-Based Digital Signature Standard
ARM Architecture Reference Manual ARMv8, for ARMv8-A architecture profile (NEON Instruction Set)
